verdict.rationale: n8n documents a public REST API with a complete endpoint reference generated from an OpenAPI 3.0 spec. It has versioned base URLs for Cloud and self-hosted instances, plus interactive playgrounds (the docs-site runner and a built-in Swagger UI on self-hosted). missing for 10: API deprecation/stability policy and public-API changelog, an advertised OpenAPI download at standard paths (the probe found 404s; the spec exists only in-repo), and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This section is the complete endpoint reference for n8n's public REST API, generated from the OpenAPI specification
The n8n API comes with a built-in Swagger UI playground in self-hosted versions. This provides interactive documentation, where you can try out requests.
The official n8n-io/n8n repository carries the n8n Public API's OpenAPI 3.0.0 specification
